verified_sources.source_name: Fayrouz Kuwait Water & Moisture Remediation Services

extracted_facts.diagnostic_inspection_kwd: Free with repair contract or 15 to 25 KWD for electronic acoustic/thermal leak detection.
extracted_facts.localized_wall_repair_kwd: 30 to 60 KWD per wall (scraping damaged plaster, cementitious waterproof primer, anti-salt putty, and 2 topcoats).
extracted_facts.rising_damp_or_bathroom_leak_kwd: 70 to 140 KWD per wall if plumbing pipe replacement or crystalline barrier injection is required.
extracted_facts.cure_time: Must allow wall to dry for 3 to 7 days before applying finish paint.

extracted_facts.common_causes_in_kuwait: AC condensate drain overflows (نش درين التكييف), bathroom tile grouting failure, cracked exterior facade plaster, and high groundwater tables in South Surra and coastal districts.
